TOP — s(11) = s-hat, equality only for Trump mod G (S1) [open — own work done; waiting on dependencies] The composed theorem. Open until every 'open' descendant below closes. [own_tier lean-proved: the composition is already a Lean theorem from the axioms]

A.D1 — Attainment: s(11) is a minimum (D1) [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A68): Lean theorem attained_thm (axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound only). No Hausdorff limits: compactness of the coordinate feasible region (33 coords + side in [0,11]; containment = the set_subset_container_iff inequalities, non-overlap closed because interior(PSq.set) = the OPEN u/v box, mem_interior_iff_uv) + continuity of the side projection; explicit 11-in-a-row packing for nonemptiness; parametrize (A64) maps set-level packings in. TopLevel roster 13 -> 12 named axioms.

A.PARAM — Every packing is represented in (cx,cy,t), t in [0,1] [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A64): prose + Lean theorem (axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound only). The square's own 90-degree symmetry (sqSet_rot) brings the edge vector into the closed first quadrant; the half-angle substitution t = e2/(1+e1) is exact algebra - no transcendental functions. Also provides the u/v membership and w-containment characterisations + w quasiconcavity that the measure bridge consumes.

A.LB382 — Theorem 1: s(11) >= 3.82 [lean-proved] Two independent exact verifiers (verify_measure.py; Lean checkMeasureI via native_decide) AND, since A64, the END-TO-END Lean theorem s_eleven_ge_382 (Measure382.lean): native_decide evaluation + the formalised bridge A.F2; axioms propext/Choice/Quot.sound + the native_decide axiom. 'Lean proves s(11) >= 3.82', not just 'Lean checks the checker'.

A.S3 — s-hat is THE octic root (isolation certificate) [lean-proved] DISCHARGED (A63). The octic has exactly 2 real roots; the one in [3.877083, 3.877084] is the second; all Taylor coefficients at the left endpoint above degree 0 are positive, so the Lean uniqueness proof is calculus-free. 5 corruption gates fail as required.

A.UBshat — Upper bound AT s-hat exactly (Trump's packing exists at s-hat) [lean-proved] ROUTE DECIDED (A63, docs/proofs/attainment_ub.md): route (b) (Fits-closed + certificate sequence) REFUTED as a finite route (scaling breaks unit squares; rational curves have rational sigma-limits). Route (a) already certifies Fits(s_A22) (A22 feasibility, Python-interval TCB); residue = the algebraic identity s_A22 = s-hat, pinned to 2.1e-47 by T1's Taylor bound; closure specs: exact number-field verification (compositum deg <= 56 - a coordinate has a degree-7 minimal polynomial, so the field is NOT Q(s-hat)) or the S3-fallback restatement with s-hat := s_A22. || A64: axiom SPLIT executed in TopLevel.lean - shatA22 + trump_packs_at_shatA22 (certified, Python-interval TCB) + shatA22_eq_shat (THE open identity, single axiom); trump_packs_at_shat now a theorem. Sign/interval route to the identity REFUTED (no separation gap without a height bound - attainment_ub.md section 6); NEW cheaper closure spec (c-idl): saturated ideal-membership cofactor certificate, verification = rational polynomial identities + one sign gate, no number-field arithmetic; search = bounded Groebner/Macaulay campaign. || A69: (c-idl) EXECUTED - certs/cidl_identity.json + certs/verify_cidl.py (PASS 0.7 s, stdlib rationals; corruption gates OK): e(t)*Delta^8*octic(S) = sum q_j G_j over the 13 reduced contact rows, sign gate via exact Sturm on [3/10,2/5]; found by exact linear elimination (no Groebner) - deg Delta 34, deg D 35, m(t) = the tan-half octic DERIVED, m | G_oct. shatA22 = shat now certificate-backed (attainment_ub.md sec 7); the A53 L4 degree-7/compositum-56 obstacle VOID (spurious A03 minpoly annotations; all coordinates lie in Q(t-hat), degree 8). Lean residue = named obligation CIDL-LEAN (sec 7.5): native_decide replay + refined A22-interface axioms; then shatA22_eq_shat becomes a theorem via shat_spec. || A78 T2 (2026-09-02): CIDL-LEAN DISCHARGED - CidlPoly/CidlGen/CidlData/CidlCheck/CidlBridge.lean replay certs/cidl_identity.json by native_decide (generators REBUILT from A22 conventions; identity + octic + sign gates, 27 s); sign gates proved STRONGER (e<0, Delta<0 on [3/10,2/5]); axiom shatA22_eq_shat replaced by a22_exact_structure (A22 certified content only: t-hat in [3/10,2/5], s_A22 in the isolating interval, 13 generators vanish at P-hat built from zhat). The node's residual trust = the A22 interface (E.A22, A79), no algebra.
